_comment: Source of truth for the required status checks on main. Apply a change with
and read the live ruleset back afterwards.
Only the required_status_checks rule lives here. The org ruleset 'Protect
default branches' already blocks deletion and force-push and requires a
pull request, so repeating those rules here would add nothing.
No approval is required: outside contributors cannot merge, and the
maintainer's account is the only one that can. Every merge follows the house
merging skill: a fresh-context review, then a merge at the literal reviewed
Every context must report on every pull request. A required check that
path filters skip never reports and blocks the pull request forever, which
is why voice-check runs on every pull request and lints only changed
name: main: required checks
